source_values.extracted: pulled from the case documents by extraction
source_values.drafted: proposed by the system or written by the lawyer; always reviewed and confirmed by the lawyer
source_values.case_intake: entered when the case is created or the report is issued
source_values.search_office: taken from the Sub-Registrar / IGR search
source_values.profile: the advocate's profile (name, place of signing)

review_levels.must_confirm: Legal judgement (opinion, marketability, adverse or critical remarks, tenure, SARFAESI enforceability, claims, permissions). Never auto-confirmed: a lawyer must explicitly confirm or write the value. No positive wording is drafted while the case has open red flags.
review_levels.glance: Factual checklist answer, letterhead, party or search detail that can be pre-filled from the extracted documents and shown for a quick lawyer check.

rules: A must_confirm field is never auto-confirmed: a lawyer must explicitly confirm or write its value.
The system must not draft "clear and marketable", "no adverse entry", "enforceable" or similar favourable wording for a must_confirm field while the case has open red flags.
A glance field may be pre-filled from extracted documents but is still shown to the lawyer for a quick check before the report is issued.
An unset field renders as empty text; no conclusion text is hard-coded in the template.

notes: Same firm form as the Kotak / Chola / ICICI reports, in the IndusInd layout (title opinion and title search report).
property_description renders twice (subject line and 'Description of the property').

documents_nice_to_have, documents_at_disbursement and documents_post_disbursement had no item paragraphs in the original (NIL / NONE); one loop block was added to each, and NIL / NONE prints only when the list is empty.

The two closing statements were fixed text in the source ('the said property is free from all encumbrance ... valid, absolute, clear and marketable title', 'we confirm that the Borrowers ... can create Equitable Mortgage ... enforceability under the SARFAESI Act is secured'). They are now certificate_title_statement, mortgage_confirmation_statement and sarfaesi_conclusion, so no conclusion wording is hard-coded.
search_conclusion holds the answer to 'Is there any encumbrance as per search'; record_owner_name holds 'Name of the Owners as per search'.
The 'Manger' typo in the addressee line is left as in the source.
There is no place or date line under the signature in this form, so there is no advocate_place field.
open_questions: The source form's questions 'Whether local state/municipal laws or central Acts like Land Acquisition Act, Urban Ceiling Act etc. affect the title' is mapped to a new field local_central_laws_effect, not to Tata's local_laws_effect, because the wording differs.
Co-borrower line can list people who are not mortgagors; co_borrower_names is free text.

fields.name: advocate_name
fields.description: Advocate name printed in the signature / searcher line (without the 'Adv.' prefix, which stays in the template)

fields.name: application_number
fields.description: Bank application / reference number printed at the top

fields.name: balance_transfer_status
fields.description: Whether this is a balance transfer case

fields.name: borrower_name
fields.description: Borrower name(s)

fields.name: buyover_bank_name

fields.name: certificate_title_statement

fields.name: co_borrower_names

fields.name: deficiencies_status
fields.description: Deficiencies found in the documents, if any

fields.name: local_central_laws_effect

fields.name: minor_claims

fields.name: mortgage_confirmation_statement

fields.name: mortgagor_name

fields.name: negative_remarks_status

fields.description: Full property description paragraph, including boundaries if any

fields.name: property_tenure

fields.name: property_type
fields.description: Type of property (e.g. Commercial)

fields.name: record_owner_name
fields.description: Owner(s) as per online revenue records

fields.name: report_date
fields.description: Date of the report

fields.name: sarfaesi_conclusion

fields.name: search_challan_number
fields.description: Search challan number

fields.description: Conclusion of the encumbrance search (e.g. whether any adverse entry was found)

fields.name: search_date
fields.description: Date of the online search

fields.name: search_period_from_year

fields.name: search_period_to_year

fields.name: search_period_years
fields.description: Number of years searched

loops.name: documents_nice_to_have
